title: Agent Learning Episode Created Event
description: Normalized episode synthesized from one or more learning observations

episode_id.description: Stable identifier for the synthesized episode

agent_name.description: Name of the agent whose behavior produced the episode

session_key.description: Session identifier associated with the episode

summary.description: Compact summary of what happened and why it mattered

source_observation_ids.description: Observation ids rolled up into this episode

task_tags.description: Task tags carried forward for grouping and retrieval

failure_mode.description: Normalized failure class if the episode captured a miss

fix_summary.description: Summary of the fix or adjustment that improved the outcome

user_feedback_summary.description: Redacted summary of explicit user feedback
